items.title: Neon Among Mobs
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Dear astronaut!

We've got a serious problem, we've just got word from Base Neon that two agents in your mission team are from an enemy base! We don't know who they are but they could be anyone! The only person we could trust is you. Work hard to discover which of your neon team members are the liars!

~Colorful skins
~20 designs to choose from

items.title: Mini Me!
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description: Mini us, mini you, Mini Me! Have the biggest fun on the smallest scale with these adorable themed skins! See the city through new eyes with friends and have the adventure you’ve been itching for! Whether you’re causing havoc with TNT, hoarding all your diamonds away in a chest, or just need a cake with you 24/7, we’ve got you covered with the Mini Me! skin pack!

items.title: Free Style Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Satisfy your trendy fashion needs with these cute, but cool vibrant skins! No matter what style or color, these skins are sure to be the center of attention in any city or world! Rock the stage and be yourself!

- 12 cool skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Dinosaur Onesies
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Catch the attention of your friends with these cute dinosaur onesie skins. Perfect for roleplay.
One free skin!

items.title: Glow Style
items.creator: Diveblocks
items.description:
Stand out in the crowd this season with stylish glowing clothing. From fluorescent dresses to neon t-shirts. Be on trend and turn heads in our brand new Glow Style!

By Colibri Studios

items.title: Pink Party
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: It's a party and everyone is wearing pink this season! Fun and bright, pink looks great on everyone! Join your friends in one of these trendy outfits!

items.title: Patriotic Pups
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These adorable, patriotic pups are all dressed up and ready to get grilling, chowing, chasing cats, and enjoying the outdoors. Their red, white and blue costumes are a hit at every paw party. Perfect for woofing at those amazing fireworks, playin fetch, or even jumping in the pool. 6 U-S-of-A pups in all. Happy Fourth ya'll!

items.title: Luxurious Summer
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Live this summer surrounded by all the luxuries of life! Summer is finally here. Your plans for a fantastic summer of hanging out at the beach, shopping, and sleeping in. You've earned it, having worked hard during school. Now you're ready to show you can play even harder.

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Myths & Legends
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
They're the ones you've heard the adventurous stories about, the ones that appeared on the face of the earth without a clear explanation, the Myths & Legends!
Roleplay together with your friends as Ghoul & Dark Elf, or scare others as you jump into the Demon skin!

+ 8 detailed skins
+ 1 Cyclops FREE skin!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Zombie Gamers
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
The apocalypse has arrived and now you live in a game! Be it a stylish zombie or a great survivor with these perfect RPG skins!

- 12 skins
- 2 free skins

items.title: Jungle Maze
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: Don't get lost! This challenging maze was created by the jungle elementals, if you manage to find your way to the cave city all the secrets will be revealed!

items.title: Social Teen Pack
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Are you a social person online? Show it to other players by wearing one of these stylish outfits, and head out on epic adventures!

- 40 unique skins!
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Tardiwave

items.title: Metallurgy Merch June 2021
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
The first of the M-Series drops! Rep your favorite skin pack creators with some branded fashion! Dripping with style, these skins have a variety of looks to help you represent your true self!

- Includes 17 Metallurgy Blockworks merch skins!
- 12 teen skins and 5 Lurge skins

items.title: Candy Stylish Teens
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
The Candy fashion looks very cute and delicious! 

+11 Skins
by UnderBlocks

items.title: Robots
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay as a teen robot! 

+ 12 robot skins
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Orarium
items.creator: A30x1
items.description:
A mysterious tower appeared in the world, and ancient civilization created a city around this magnificent monument! For over one hundred years the secrets from this tower have been hidden from the citizens. Be the first to adventure in orarium!

+ Maze
+ Parkour

items.title: Cloud Land
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: In the top of the world, the cloud land is safe from monsters and risks of the outside world. With cute farms and a friendly neighborhood!

items.title: Gear Airport
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: Zeppelins flying around in this giant and amazing airport! Go into giant flying gadgets made by the crazy "steamtist"!

items.title: Elf City
items.creator: A30x1
items.description:
The friendly elves created an amazing looking city for you to explore and adventure yourself, try it out!

+ A little parkour inside a cave!
+ Tree houses for you to live in!

items.title: Millionaire Underground Base
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Discover the Millionaire Underground Base and have fun surviving in luxury! A secret base underground with all you need to survive and have fun with your friends!

items.title: Nordic Island
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Nordics are great warriors of ancient times. They come out from the seas with little warning. Live like a Nord. Battle and protect your village from enemies!

By Street Studios

items.title: Unicorn Princess
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Unicorns with glowing rainbow hair you can ride! Rule the kingdom with your cute rainbow friends! 

- Baby glowing unicorns!
- Princess skins

items.title: Anime Card Masters
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Do you want to be a card master? Join the academy and become a professional card master!

- 10 unique skins!
- By Pixelusion & Rvan Studios

items.title: Gamers Parkour
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Welcome to Gamers Parkour a fun Minecraft parkour adventure featuring 10 challenging levels that range from going though different dimensions to jumping across planets! play with friends or alone and don’t forget to have fun!

- 10 levels in total.
- By: Dannny0117 + MorganCreedFTW.
- Published By: Canada Web Developer.
